# SD13-E2 deterministic Half-Orc Fighter level 1 race-semantics recognition
# fixture. Represents a deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Half-Orc Fighter level 1
# identity as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain
# derived, computed, or parity values.
#
# Like Half-Elf, PF1 Core Half-Orc grants a player-chosen +2 to any one ability
# score, mirroring the Human ability-bonus mechanic's shape (a named choice, not
# a fixed pair).
#
# The Fighter combat baseline, total saves, and selected-skill modifiers stay
# claim-blocked on this input because the bounded GE-06 Fighter compute path is
# grounded only for race:human; that is expected and unrelated to this fixture's
# purpose, which is to make the bounded Half-Orc race-semantics recognition
# legible. It deliberately avoids every unproven Half-Orc family: no
# Intimidating skill bonus, no Orc Ferocity, and no weapon familiarity grant.
case_id=pf1-crb-half-orc-fighter-level1-recognition
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:half-orc
class_level=class:fighter:1
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:12
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:10
ability=charisma:8
choice=choice:half_orc_ability_bonus:ability:strength
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
